remainingAny.reason: One React context must carry distinct form schemas; provider/consumer restore caller generic. Replacing it with invariant Record schema rejects typed reset callbacks.

fixes: Forwarded refs for Button, IconButton, ToggleButton, Tab, InputBase, Slider and generic Select support the declared React18 baseline.
FieldFrame has explicit htmlFor/id association, so leading adornment buttons cannot steal label activation.
TextField, TextArea and Autocomplete honor public style; error aria-invalid is consistent across text area, autocomplete, select and date.
Boolean accessible names/descriptions are forwarded to the native input.
Autocomplete unique list IDs, active descendant, native event handlers, IME safety, locked state, Tab/Escape and dynamic option recovery; selected key reopens all options.
Shared active-option visibility adjusts only local option-list scroll for Autocomplete and PeoplePicker without moving typing focus.
ChipField respects consumer disabled state at max; TagInput and PeoplePicker honor IME, lock, Tab and popup state.
Chip text input may shrink inside a narrow container with 200% text instead of overflowing.
ColorPicker disabled state covers inline inputs/buttons/sliders; color plane has complete numeric ARIA value attributes.
Select chooses enabled defaults, disables form value, implements native required validation and visible invalid focus; localized built-in options retain selection.
DatePicker native required validation, stable locale hooks, valid group semantics for calendar buttons, and disabled popup handling.
NumberField step=any nudges by a finite unit instead of emitting infinity.
FilePicker drop respects multiple=false.
useForm reads dotted-path errors and reveals invalid field errors on submit.
ThemePicker radio semantics, roving tab stop and arrow/Home/End selection share props across swatches and custom cards.
Light theme option text uses semantic text tokens instead of forced white.
CollapsibleSection restores rejected controlled native toggles before emitting the request.
SignalBars normalizes finite bar count/strength and announces the value it actually paints.
DataTable page-size actions emit one state change; structural row counts and initial resize aria values are accurate in covered cases.
ColorPicker accessible name contains its visible hex value; FilePicker avatar action includes owner name; DataTable example action names retain visible wording.

Select preserves layout style on its frame and public id/data/ARIA on its trigger; useFieldIds consistently honors explicit accessible names/references across10 fields; TagInput/PeoplePicker retain public data hooks through mark.
SplitButton items reuses MenuProps items through a type-only import; private form path traversal uses unknown and preserves typed roots/arrays without any or assertions.
10 side-effect-free React factories marked PURE to preserve package tree shaking, removing unrelated illustrations and media from Button-only bundles.

Select and ColorPicker accessible names combine the field name and actual rendered value/placeholder. Explicit aria-labelledby chains retain priority, aria-label is preserved through a self reference, and rich value nodes remain readable without text coercion.
compatibilityNotes: Select's synthetic built-in option values are stable original keys when locale changes; application-specific selects should continue to supply explicit options.
DatePicker calendar retains native date buttons in a labelled group; no unsupported ARIA grid keyboard contract is claimed.
Native required Select validation is backed by a hidden select; named form serialization retains the previous hidden input value contract.
Ref public prop types preserved, including Select<V>; forwardRef generic cast is limited to the React boundary.

Existing compound picker id/data root placement retained; Select previously dropped those props and now places them on the native button, like text fields. className/style are layout concerns. Explicit ARIA names override generated field labels; Select/ColorPicker append the rendered value automatically, so exact accessible-name queries include that value.
Malformed SplitButton menu items (non-string labels, non-function onSelect) now fail type checking consistently with Menu; valid existing docs/menu consumers are unchanged.
